cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll sort out those six silent weeks now. First, tell me what you think they did to me; then I'll listen to the phone explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone really did break. I need you to believe that before I can answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. Phone settled. Take as long as you need on the other part; I'm not asking for a perfect speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You thought I'd stopped caring. I don't know how to say how sorry I am.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then don't start with sorry. I'll read one of the messages I kept rewriting, trying to make it easier to answer. You can just tell me if you understand why I was changing myself. We'll do one at a time.
